title: How does a customer pay a demurrage and detention balance by card?
content:
## Situation of use and capability

Within the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, this tool lets the billed party pay money owed on one container's free-time record by card, as its own payment. The customer authorises a card payment of the stated amount against the record: one payment entry dated today is written on the record with the customer's own payment reference, and the balance owed on the record goes down by the amount paid. The customer then sees the payment and the remaining balance on the record.

## How it is invoked

The tool is **pay_dnd_balance_a831ef2f**. It is the customer's own tool: it must first be unlocked (unlock, through unlock_user_discoverable_tool) and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| dnd_id | Reference number of the free-time record being paid, as given to the customer by the desk from the free-time record lookup | identifier |
| payment_reference | The payment reference the customer quotes for this payment | verbatim: copied character for character exactly as the customer states it, preserving letters, digits and punctuation, with no translation, normalisation, summarising, addition or deletion |
| amount_usd | Amount paid | USD, a positive figure given to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A successful payment answers "Card payment (payment entry reference) of USD (amount) with reference (payment reference) applied to record (record reference); balance due now USD (balance)." The balance is the record's outstanding amount in USD to 2 decimal places after the payment. An answer starting with "Error:" means no record exists under that reference and nothing was paid.

## Contract questions

**Q: The customer quotes the reference "rem 2231-B". How is it passed?**
A: Exactly as stated, including the space, the hyphen and the capital letter.

**Q: Who runs the payment?**
A: The customer themselves, after the tool has been unlocked and handed over.
